definition.name: Influencer Campaign Management
definition.overview:
An **Influencer Campaign Management** application is the brand-side system for executing creator marketing campaigns: it holds each campaign as a managed unit, binds the participating creators to it, specifies what content they must deliver, collects and reviews that content against the campaign, and reports the campaign's progress and results.

The defining core is small:

```text
Campaign (the managed unit)
└── Per-creator participation records, carried through a managed workflow
    └── Brief / deliverable specification (what content, where, when)
        └── Content bound to the campaign (drafts and published posts)
            └── Campaign-level progress and results
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — incentive payments, application pages, creator portals, e-signed contracts, automated content collection, tracking links, paid amplification — is standard capability layered on this core, not what makes the application what it is.

One market-structure fact matters for reading this document: in the current market, this campaign-execution capability is usually delivered as the core module of a broader influencer-marketing platform that also carries creator discovery, relationship management, and program-level measurement. The Type described here is the execution layer itself; the relationship to the broader platform category is addressed under Related Application Types.
definition.overview_zh:
一款**网红活动管理**应用是品牌方用于执行创作者营销活动的系统：它将每个活动作为一个受管理的单元，将参与的创作者绑定到该活动上，规定他们必须交付的内容，收集并针对活动审查这些内容，并报告活动的进度和结果。

其定义性的核心很小：

```text
活动（受管理的单元）
└── 每个创作者的参与记录，通过受管理的工作流贯穿
     └── 简报/交付物规范（什么内容，在哪里，何时）
         └── 绑定到活动的内容（草稿和已发布帖子）
             └── 活动级别的进度和结果
```

通常与该类别相关联的其他所有内容——激励支付、申请页面、创作者门户、电子签名合同、自动化内容收集、追踪链接、付费推广——都是叠加在这个核心之上的标准能力，而非决定该应用本质的因素。

一个市场结构事实对于阅读本文档很重要：在当前市场中，这种活动执行能力通常作为更广泛的网红营销平台的核心模块提供，该平台还包含创作者发现、关系管理和项目级别的衡量。此处描述的类型是执行层本身；与更广泛平台类别的关系在“相关应用类型”下讨论。
definition.dc:
**Campaign.** The central object: a brand-defined, time-bounded creator-marketing effort. A campaign carries its identity (name, description), its scope (goals, platforms, timeline), and commonly a budget. Everything else in the system hangs off campaigns. Products use different words for the same container — campaign, project, activation — and at least one major product has renamed it over time while keeping the structure; the container, not the label, is the invariant.

**Participation record.** Each creator bound to a campaign has a per-campaign participation record: who they are, how they entered (directly added, invited, or accepted from an application), what they owe, what they have delivered, what they are owed, and where they currently stand in the campaign workflow. The participation record — not the creator's global profile — is what the campaign workflow moves forward. A creator can participate in many campaigns; each campaign holds its own record.

**Brief / deliverables.** The campaign specifies what participants must produce: content types and counts per platform (posts, videos, stories), due dates, required elements (hashtags, brand-handle mentions, links), creative direction (concept, key messages, references, dos and don'ts), and disclosure expectations for sponsored content. The brief is the campaign's creator-facing contract of expectations; deliverables are its trackable units.

**Content bound to the campaign.** The content participants produce — draft submissions awaiting review and published posts — is attached to the campaign and to the responsible creator's participation record. Collection may be manual (the creator uploads or the brand logs the URL) or automated (the system detects posts mentioning the brand and assigns them to the campaign). What matters structurally is the binding: content without a campaign attachment is outside this application's world.

**Progress and results.** The campaign exposes where every participant stands (which obligations are done, late, or missing) and what the campaign produced (published content and its performance). This is the management surface that distinguishes the Type from a messaging thread or a shared drive: the brand sees the whole campaign as a managed population, not as scattered conversations.
definition.dc_zh:
**活动。** 中心对象：一个品牌定义的、时间受限的创作者营销努力。活动承载其身份（名称、描述）、其范围（目标、平台、时间线），通常还有一个预算。系统中的其他一切都挂靠在活动上。产品对同一容器使用不同的词——活动、项目、激活——并且至少有一个主要产品随时间重新命名了它，但保持了结构；容器，而不是标签，是不变的。

**参与记录。** 每个绑定到活动的创作者都有一个按活动划分的参与记录：他们是谁、如何加入（直接添加、邀请或从申请接受）、他们欠什么、他们交付了什么、他们被欠什么，以及他们在活动工作流中的当前位置。参与记录——而不是创作者的全局资料——是活动工作流推进的内容。一个创作者可以参与许多活动；每个活动持有自己的记录。

**简报/交付物。** 活动指定参与者必须生产的内容：每个平台的内容类型和数量（帖子、视频、故事）、截止日期、必要元素（标签、品牌账号提及、链接）、创意方向（概念、关键信息、参考、注意事项和禁止事项），以及赞助内容的披露期望。简报是活动面向创作者的期望合同；交付物是...
definition.rules:
- **The campaign gates its own structure.** Setup is editable while the campaign is in draft; once live, workflow changes are restricted (typically only removal of unused stages). This protects in-flight participant states.
- **Participation is per campaign.** Being dropped from one campaign does not end the creator's relationship with the brand's program; it only marks them inactive in that campaign. The same creator appears in many campaigns with independent records.
- **Automation advances, humans reverse.** In products with workflow automation, submissions, confirmations, and fulfilled payments can auto-advance a participant; reversing a state (sending a draft back, dropping a participant) remains a human decision.
- **Review stages operate as a linked pair.** Where pre-publication approval exists, a submission stage and a review stage are linked rather than independent toggles — one documented product treats enabling one without the other as a misconfiguration, and a second ties content review to its brief stage structurally.
- **Review outcomes typically distinguish three cases.** Full approval; approval with corrections (minor edits, no resubmission); needs work (substantial revision, new version required). Versions are tracked per deliverable.
- **Terms precede participation.** Creators accept the campaign's terms — including content-rights and disclosure expectations — as part of onboarding; compensation expectations are shown before acceptance.
- **Disclosure is a brief concern.** Sponsored-content disclosure expectations (clear and prominent ad disclosure, in the post's language, positioned per platform norms) are commonly specified in the brief and checked during review.
- **Content belongs to a campaign.** Collected content can be bound, unbound, or moved between campaigns; the binding determines which campaign's results the content counts toward.
- **Money moves deliberately.** Payment actions in payment stages mark incentives fulfilled and reflect against the campaign budget; some products require an explicit confirmation before funds move.
definition.rules_zh:
- **活动门控其自身结构。** 当活动处于草稿状态时，设置可编辑；一旦上线，工作流更改受到限制（通常仅允许移除未使用的阶段）。这保护了进行中的参与者状态。
- **参与是按活动进行的。** 从一个活动中被移除不会结束创作者与品牌项目的关系；它仅将其标记为该活动中的非活跃状态。同一创作者出现在许多活动中，具有独立的记录。
- **自动化推进，人工逆转。** 在具有工作流自动化的产品中，提交、确认和已完成的支付可以自动推进参与者；逆转状态（将草稿退回、移除参与者）仍然是人工决策。
- **审查阶段作为链接对操作。** 在存在发布前批准的地方，提交阶段和审查阶段是链接的，而不是独立的开关——一个记录在案的产品将启用一个而不启用另一个视为配置错误，另一个产品将内容审查与其简报阶段在结构上绑定。
- **审查结果通常区分三种情况。** 完全批准；带更正的批准（小修改，无需重新提交）；需要工作（重大修订，需要新版本）。版本按交付物追踪。
- **条款先于参与。** 创作者在入职过程中接受活动的条款——包括内容权利和披露期望；补偿期望在接受前显示。
- **披露是简报关注点。** 赞助内容披露期望（清晰且醒目的广告披露，使用帖子语言，按平台规范定位）通常在简报中指定，并在审查期间检查。
- **内容属于活动。** 收集的内容可以绑定、解绑或移动

definition.name: Influencer Marketing Platform
definition.overview:
An **Influencer Marketing Platform** is the brand-side system for managing an organization's creator program: it holds content creators — independent people who publish to their own audiences on social platforms — as a managed population of records, provides discovery and evaluation machinery for selecting collaboration partners from that population, and maintains a relationship with each creator that persists across engagements. Campaigns with creators are run through it, but the platform's center of gravity is the creator relationship over time and the program built around it.

The defining core is small:

```text
Creator record (identified content creator: identity, channels, audience, history)
└── Discovery & evaluation over the managed creator population
└── Relationship record: the brand's standing with each creator, persisting across engagements
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — million-scale discovery databases, campaign execution, payment rails, gifting, creator portals, benchmarking, AI matching — is standard capability layered on this core, not what makes the platform what it is. When the dominant structure is the campaign container itself rather than the creator population, the product is drifting toward the related Type Influencer Campaign Management; when it becomes a two-sided venue where creators are transacting participants, it is a Brand-Creator Marketplace.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**网红营销平台**是品牌方用于管理组织创作者计划的系统：它将内容创作者——即在社交平台上向自有受众发布内容的独立个人——作为受管理的记录群体进行存储，提供用于从该群体中选择合作对象的发现与评估机制，并维护与每位创作者的跨活动持续性关系。与创作者的活动通过该平台运行，但平台的重心在于随时间推移的创作者关系以及围绕其构建的计划。

其定义性核心很小：

```text
创作者记录（已识别的内容创作者：身份、渠道、受众、历史）
└── 针对受管理创作者群体的发现与评估
└── 关系记录：品牌与每位创作者的长期状态，跨活动持续存在
```

通常与该类别关联的其他所有内容——百万级发现数据库、活动执行、支付通道、礼品赠送、创作者门户、基准测试、AI匹配——都是叠加在此核心之上的标准能力，而非决定平台本质的因素。当主导结构是活动容器本身而非创作者群体时，该产品正在向相关的类型“网红活动管理”漂移；当它变成创作者作为交易参与方的双边场所时，它就是一个品牌-创作者市场。
definition.dc:
**Creator record.** The central object: an identified person (or organization) who creates content for their own audience. The record carries identity, the creator's channels and handles, audience attributes (size and, where available, composition and geography), and the history of the brand's interactions with them. Records accumulate in two ways — found through the platform's discovery machinery, and added from the brand's own relationships. A creator the brand has never worked with and a long-standing partner are the same kind of object with different standing; that continuity is the point of the record.

**Discovery & evaluation.** The machinery for answering "who should we work with?": search and filtering over the population, comparison of candidates, and vetting — audience fit, content and brand fit, past performance, and audience quality (whether the audience is real and engaged). Evaluation draws on the record's data and on the brand's own criteria; the specific techniques (metrics, scores, predictive estimates, manual review) are implementations of one structure: judging creators against the brand's needs before committing.

**Relationship across engagements.** The brand's standing with each creator, held separately from any single campaign: current status in the program (discovered, in outreach, active partner, past), collaboration history, communications, notes, tags and lists, and ownership within the marketing team. This is what makes the platform a program system rather than a campaign tool — the record accumulates across campaigns and survives between them, and a creator who performed well once is visible, reachable, and re-engageable later.
definition.dc_zh:
**创作者记录。** 核心对象：一个已识别的个人（或组织），为其自有受众创作内容。该记录承载身份信息、创作者的渠道与账号、受众属性（规模以及可用的内容构成与地理分布），以及品牌与其互动的历史。记录通过两种方式累积——通过平台的发现机制找到，以及从品牌自有的关系中添加。一个品牌从未合作过的创作者和一位长期合作伙伴是同一类对象，但地位不同；这种连续性正是记录的意义所在。

**发现与评估。** 用于回答“我们应该与谁合作”的机制：在创作者群体中进行搜索和筛选、候选者比较，以及审查——包括受众匹配度、内容与品牌契合度、过往表现，以及受众质量（受众是否真实且活跃）。评估过程依据记录中的数据以及品牌自身的标准；具体技术手段（指标、评分、预测估算、人工审核）都是以下结构的实现方式：在品牌承诺合作之前，根据品牌需求评判创作者。

**跨互动的关系。** 品牌与每位创作者的关系状态，独立于任何单一活动之外：在项目中的当前状态（已发现、沟通中、活跃合作伙伴、过往）、合作历史、沟通记录、备注、标签。
definition.rules:
- **The creator record is the unit of continuity.** Content, results, payments, and communications attach back to creators, not only to campaigns. This is the load-bearing rule that separates the platform from campaign tooling: drop a creator from a campaign and the relationship record remains; finish a campaign and the creator's history persists into the next cycle.
- **Two populations coexist.** The discovered-but-not-yet-worked-with population and the known-partner population are held in the same object model with different statuses; a record moves between them through outreach and collaboration, and moving back (a lapsed partner becoming a prospect again) is normal.
- **Metrics are vendor-collected estimates.** Audience, reach, and performance data come from platform data collection and vendor measurement models; numbers such as estimated media value or audience authenticity are computed estimates whose methods and refresh behavior are product-specific, not neutral facts. Treat them as decision inputs, not audited figures.
- **Compensation may be executed or recorded.** Some products move money themselves (with tax-compliance machinery); others record terms and incentives while payment executes through partners or outside the tool. Either way, incentive state is tracked on the relationship and campaign records.
- **Creators are external parties.** Consent and privacy surfaces for creator data, and payment compliance for creator earnings, are structural parts of the system in products that operate at scale — the platform holds personal data about people it does not employ.
- **Program reporting aggregates; campaign reporting itemizes.** The platform's characteristic reporting view is the cross-campaign, cross-market rollup — a view that only exists because the creator population and its history outlive individual campaigns.
- **Recruitment portals stay brand-side.** Application pages and creator portals collect supply for the brand's program; they do not by themselves make the product a venue where creators transact with many brands.
definition.rules_zh:
- **创作者记录是连续性的单位。** 内容、结果、支付和沟通回附到创作者，而不仅仅是活动。这是将平台与活动工具区分开来的承重规则：从活动中移除一位创作者，关系记录仍然存在；完成一个活动，创作者的历史会持续到下一个周期。
- **两个群体共存。** 已发现但尚未合作的群体与已知合作伙伴群体以不同状态保存在同一对象模型中；记录通过外联和合作在它们之间移动，反向移动（过期的合作伙伴再次成为潜在客户）是正常的。
- **指标是供应商收集的估计值。** 受众、触达和绩效数据来自平台数据收集和供应商测量模型；诸如估计媒体价值或受众真实性等数字是计算出的估计值，其方法和刷新行为因产品而异，并非中立事实。将它们视为决策输入，而非审计数字。
- **补偿可能由系统执行或记录。** 某些产品自行移动资金（带有税务合规机制）；其他产品记录条款和激励措施，而支付通过合作伙伴或工具外部执行。无论哪种方式，激励状态都在关系和活动记录中跟踪。
- **创作者是外部方。** 在大规模运营的产品中，创作者数据的同意和隐私界面，以及创作者收入的支付合规性，是系统的结构性部分——平台持有其未雇佣人员的个人数据。
- **计划报告聚合；活动报告逐项列出。** 平台的特征报告视图是跨活动、跨市场的汇总——这种视图仅因创作者

definition.name: Landing Page Optimization Platform
definition.overview:
A **Landing Page Optimization Platform** is a marketing application whose center is the campaign landing page: the platform builds the page without code, publishes and hosts it at a public URL, measures its visitors against a defined conversion goal, and improves it through a continuous variant-and-routing optimization loop.

The defining core has three inseparable parts:

```text
Campaign landing page (built in the platform, hosted at a public URL, managed in a portfolio)
└── Conversion goal + per-page conversion measurement
    └── Variant-and-routing optimization loop
        (create variants → allocate visitors → compare → promote winner → iterate)
```

Remove the page building and hosting and what remains is an A/B testing platform applied to pages it does not own. Remove the optimization loop and what remains is a plain landing page builder that stops at publish. Remove the conversion measurement and the page has no reason to exist as a marketing object. The Type is the conjunction of all three.

Everything else commonly associated with the category — AI page generation, heatmaps, adaptive traffic routing, popups, reusable blocks, ad-campaign mapping — is standard in current products but not what makes the product this Type. Older template-plus-split-testing versions of these products satisfy the same core without any of the modern additions.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**落地页优化平台**是一种营销应用，其核心是活动落地页：该平台无需代码即可构建页面，在公共 URL 上发布并托管，针对定义的转化目标衡量其访客，并通过持续的变体与路由优化循环进行改进。

其定义性核心包含三个不可分割的部分：

```text
活动落地页（在平台内构建，托管于公共 URL，在组合中管理）
└── 转化目标 + 每页转化测量
     └── 变体与路由优化循环
         （创建变体 → 分配访客 → 比较 → 提升胜者 → 迭代）
```

移除页面构建和托管，剩下的就是一个应用于非自有页面的 A/B 测试平台。移除优化循环，剩下的就是一个在发布后停止的普通落地页构建器。移除转化测量，页面作为营销对象便失去了存在的理由。该类型是这三者的结合。

通常与该类别关联的其他一切——AI 页面生成、热图、自适应流量路由、弹窗、可重用模块、广告活动映射——在当前产品中已是标准配置，但这并非使产品成为此类型的关键。这些产品的早期模板加分割测试版本，在没有任何现代附加功能的情况下，同样满足这一核心。
definition.dc: The central object is a **standalone, single-purpose web page** that lives inside the platform:
definition.dc_zh: 核心对象是一个独立的、单一目的的网页，它存在于平台内部。
definition.rules:
- **The conversion definition drives everything.** What counts as a conversion is set per page, and every metric and test result derives from it. A mis-defined goal silently invalidates the optimization loop.
- **Variant weights are probabilities, not queues.** Weights must total 100%, and assignment is probabilistic — short-run traffic splits can look uneven even at 50/50.
- **Returning visitors are sticky.** A visitor who first saw a variant generally keeps seeing that variant on return visits, even if its weight is later reduced to zero; fully retiring a variant requires deactivating it, and cached pages may serve the old version briefly afterward. (Documented directly in one sampled product; treat the exact mechanics as product-specific, the sticky-assignment pattern as general.)
- **Live changes typically require republishing.** Edits and new traffic weights apply to the live page only after a republish step (documented directly in one sampled product; the publish-then-republish flow is common across the category).
- **Custom-domain publishing depends on DNS.** The page goes live under the user's domain only once the domain's DNS records point at the platform; SSL is then provisioned by the platform.
- **Internal traffic pollutes the data.** Team visits and test conversions skew page metrics; some products offer IP filtering (typically an administrator-level control) to exclude them.
- **Optimization depth is commercialized.** Products gate testing modes, routing, heatmaps, and automation behind plan tiers, and quota usage (pages, monthly visitors, custom domains, AI credits). The specific gates vary; the pattern is universal.
- **Data ownership splits at the lead.** The platform owns page, behavior, and conversion data; captured leads are handed to the marketing stack and governed there.
definition.rules_zh:
- **转化定义驱动一切。** 什么算作转化是按页面设置的，每个指标和测试结果都由此衍生。定义错误的目标会无声地使优化循环失效。
- **变体权重是概率，而非队列。** 权重总和必须为 100%，分配是概率性的——即使在 50/50 的情况下，短期流量分割也可能看起来不均匀。
- **回访访客具有粘性。** 首次看到某个变体的访客，在回访时通常会继续看到该变体，即使其权重后来被降至零；完全退役一个变体需要将其停用，且缓存页面可能在之后短暂提供旧版本。（在一个抽样产品中直接记录；将确切机制视为特定于产品，将粘性分配模式视为通用。）
- **实时更改通常需要重新发布。** 编辑和新流量权重仅在重新发布步骤后应用于实时页面（在一个抽样产品中直接记录；发布后重新发布的流程在该类别中很常见）。
- **自定义域名发布依赖于 DNS。** 只有当域名的 DNS 记录指向平台时，页面才会在用户域名下上线；SSL 随后由平台配置。
- **内部流量污染数据。** 团队访问和测试转化会扭曲页面指标；一些产品提供 IP 过滤（通常是管理员级别的控制）以排除它们。
- **优化深度被商业化。** 产品在计划层级后设置测试模式、路由、热图和自动化的门槛，以及配额使用（页面、每月访客、自定义域名、AI 积分）。具体的门槛各不相同；但模式是普遍的。
- **数据所有权在线索处分割。** 平台拥有页面、行为和转化数据；捕获的线索被移交给营销 s

definition.name: Lead Capture Platform
definition.overview:
A **Lead Capture Platform** is the intake layer of the marketing and sales pipeline. It presents designed capture points to prospects at marketing-owned digital touchpoints, turns each completed capture into a persistent, attributed lead record, and delivers leads to the systems where follow-up happens — CRM, email marketing, marketing automation, or plain notifications.

The defining structure is small:

```text
Capture point (a designed prompt at a marketing touchpoint)
└── Completed capture (the prospect volunteers contact / qualification information)
    └── Lead record (identity fields + capture context: surface, page/campaign, time)
        └── Handoff (delivery of the lead into follow-up systems)
```

Everything the market associates with the category — popup overlays, exit-intent triggers, gamified coupon wheels, A/B testing, AI form generation, enrichment, scoring — makes captured leads more plentiful or more valuable, but is not what makes the product a lead capture platform. A plain embedded form that stores submissions and pushes them to an email tool is still unmistakably this Type.

Two exclusions shape the boundary. Capturing a lead means the *prospect volunteered* the information at a prompt; tools that identify companies from anonymous website traffic — without any visitor action — are a different Type, however similar the output. And a capture platform is an *intake layer*: it deliberately stops where the customer relationship begins. The relationship record, qualification, and nurturing live downstream in CRM and marketing-automation systems.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**线索捕获平台**是营销与销售管道的接收层。它在营销拥有的数字触点向潜在客户展示设计好的捕获点，将每次完成的捕获转化为持久且带有归因的线索记录，并将线索传递到执行后续跟进的系统——CRM、电子邮件营销、营销自动化或简单的通知。

其定义性结构很小：

```text
捕获点（营销触点上的设计提示）
└── 完成的捕获（潜在客户自愿提供联系/资格信息）
     └── 线索记录（身份字段 + 捕获上下文：界面、页面/活动、时间）
         └── 交接（将线索传递到后续跟进系统）
```

市场与该类别关联的一切——弹出层覆盖、退出意图触发器、游戏化优惠券轮盘、A/B 测试、AI 表单生成、数据丰富化、评分——都使捕获的线索更丰富或更有价值，但这并不是使产品成为线索捕获平台的原因。一个存储提交内容并将其推送到电子邮件工具的普通嵌入式表单，仍然毫无疑问属于此类型。

两个排除项塑造了边界。捕获线索意味着*潜在客户在提示下自愿*提供信息；那些从匿名网站流量中识别公司——无需任何访客操作——的工具是另一种类型，尽管输出相似。而捕获平台是一个*接收层*：它刻意在客户关系开始的地方停止。关系记录、资格认定和培育存在于下游的 CRM 和营销自动化系统中。
definition.dc:
Three properties. If any one is removed, the product stops being a lead capture platform:

- **The capture point.** A designed prompt, presented to a prospect at a marketing-owned touchpoint, that solicits the prospect's information. This is what makes a lead *captured* rather than *inferred*: the prospect takes a deliberate action — filling a form, answering questions, spinning a wheel for a coupon — that expresses interest. Without it, the product becomes visitor identification or a generic page tool.
- **The lead record.** Each completed capture becomes a persistent structured record: the volunteered identity fields (name, email, phone, answers) plus the capture context — which surface it came from, which page, when, and any tags attached to the campaign. Without it, submissions are just raw form data or analytics events; the record is what makes a submission a *lead*.
- **The handoff.** Captured leads are routed into the systems where follow-up happens — CRM, email marketing platforms, automation tools, notification emails, exports or webhooks. This is definitional because the capture platform is not the system of record for the customer relationship: its job ends where the rep's queue or the nurture program begins. Without it, the product is a dead-end data collector.
definition.dc_zh:
三个属性。如果任何一个被移除，产品就不再是线索捕获平台：

- **捕获点（The capture point）**：设计一个提示，在营销触点向潜在客户展示，征求其信息。这使得线索被“捕获”而非“推断”：潜在客户采取故意行动——填写表单、回答问题、转轮获取优惠券——表达兴趣。如果没有它，产品变成访问者识别或通用页面工具。

- **线索记录（The lead record）**：每次完成捕获成为一个持久的结构化记录：包括自愿提供的身份字段（姓名、邮箱、电话、回答）加上捕获上下文——来自哪个表面、哪个页面、何时，以及附加到活动的任何标签。如果没有它，提交只是原始表单数据或分析事件；记录使得提交成为“线索”。

- **交接（The handoff）**：捕获的线索被路由到后续处理系统——CRM、电子邮件营销平台、自动化工具、通知邮件、导出或webhook。这是定义性的，因为捕获平台不是客户关系的记录系统：它的工作在代表的队列或培育计划开始时结束。如果没有它，产品是死胡同数据收集器。
definition.rules:
### The platform is an intake layer, not the system of record

The relationship — contact history, qualification, deals — lives in CRM and marketing systems downstream. The capture platform creates and attributes leads; it does not manage them. This is why the handoff is core and why products compete on destinations and delivery reliability rather than on post-capture workflow.

### A lead is born from a volunteered action

What distinguishes a captured lead from an identified visitor is the prospect's own submission at a prompt. Products in this Type build their surfaces around earning that action — timing, offer, friction reduction — rather than around inferring identity without it.

### Repeat submissions update, not multiply

When the same person submits again, the platform updates the existing record rather than creating a duplicate. Identity matching is commonly anchored on the email address, with visitor-cookie matching as a supplement; some products can instead be set to always create a new record.

### Not every submission becomes a lead

Quality filtering sits between capture and record: disposable addresses, spam, and suspicious entries may register as a *submission* but be rejected as *leads*. Conversion counts and lead counts can therefore legitimately differ — the first measures form activity, the second measures usable, unique records.

### Attribution travels with the lead

The record carries its origin — surface, page or URL, campaign, timestamp, tags. Without this context the lead is just a contact; with it, marketing can answer which pages and offers produce pipeline.

### Captured data is personal data

Capture platforms hold prospects' volunteered contact information and technical traces. Deletion on request, control over stored technical data (such as IP addresses), and tracking resets are structural surfaces of the product, not afterthoughts.

### Display targeting governs the encounter

When and where the capture point appears is itself a rule system — page conditions, behavioral triggers, schedules. The same offer can be presented politely at exit or aggressively on arrival; the platform's rules decide, and the rules are part of what users configure and test.
definition.rules_zh:
### 平台是接收层，而非记录系统

关系——联系历史、资格认定、交易——存在于下游的 CRM 和营销系统中。捕获平台创建并归因线索；它不管理它们。这就是为什么交接是核心，以及为什么产品在目的地和传递可靠性上竞争，而不是在捕获后工作流上。

### 线索诞生于自愿行动

将捕获的线索与识别的访客区分开来的是潜在客户在提示下的自身提交。此类型中的产品围绕赢得该行动构建其界面——时机、优惠、摩擦减少——而不是围绕在没有该行动的情况下推断身份。

### 重复提交更新，而非增加

当同一个人再次提交时，平台更新现有记录而不是创建重复项。身份匹配通常以电子邮件地址为锚点，访客 Cookie 匹配作为补充；一些产品可以设置为始终创建新记录。

definition.name: Marketing Attribution Platform
definition.overview:
A **Marketing Attribution Platform** is an advertiser-side measurement application that determines which marketing touchpoints deserve credit for the conversions an organization records — app installs, purchases, leads, pipeline stages, revenue — by linking recorded marketing interactions to those conversions under an explicit credit-assignment model, and by aggregating that credit into cross-channel views that inform budget and channel decisions.

The problem it exists to solve: every advertising platform reports only its own campaigns and tends to claim full credit for the same conversions. An attribution platform records the journeys, allocates each conversion's credit once under rules the advertiser controls, and reconciles the total across all channels into one independent view.

The defining core is small:

```text
Conversion of record
  ← preceded by → Attributed journey (touchpoints linked to the same user)
  → Attribution model (distributes the conversion's credit)
  → Channel / campaign / source credit aggregates
```

Everything commonly bundled with modern products — spend joins and ROAS/CPA views, de-duplication against platform-reported numbers, lookback windows, identity-resolution machinery, audience activation — is standard capability or variant, not the definition. When the center of gravity shifts to aggregate spend-effect modeling without user-level journeys, the product is drifting toward Marketing Mix Modeling; when it shifts to cross-channel KPI reporting without per-conversion credit, it is a Marketing Analytics Platform.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**营销归因平台**是一种广告主侧的测量应用，它通过在一个明确的信用分配模型下，将记录的营销互动与组织记录的转化（应用安装、购买、潜在客户、销售管道阶段、收入）关联起来，并将这些信用聚合为跨渠道视图，从而为预算和渠道决策提供依据，以此确定哪些营销触点应获得这些转化的功劳。

它旨在解决的问题是：每个广告平台仅报告其自身的活动，并倾向于为相同的转化索取全部功劳。归因平台记录用户旅程，在广告主控制的规则下将每次转化的信用分配一次，并将所有渠道的总数协调为单一独立视图。

其定义性的核心很小：

```text
记录的转化
   ← 由 → 归因旅程（关联到同一用户的触点）所先于
   → 归因模型（分配转化的信用）
   → 渠道/活动/来源信用聚合
```

现代产品中通常捆绑的一切——支出关联和 ROAS/CPA 视图、针对平台报告数字的去重、回溯窗口、身份解析机制、受众激活——都是标准功能或变体，而非定义本身。当重心转向没有用户级旅程的聚合支出效果建模时，该产品正在向营销组合建模（Marketing Mix Modeling）漂移；当重心转向没有每次转化信用的跨渠道 KPI 报告时，它就是一个营销分析平台。
definition.dc:
- **Channel taxonomy mapping** — machinery that maps raw touchpoints (URL parameters, referrers, vendor names) into a managed channel / source / campaign hierarchy, with unmapped events surfaced for correction.
- **Identity resolution** — linking touchpoints to conversions across devices and sessions via device IDs, cookies, email, or (in B2B) contact-to-company mapping.
- **Reporting and export** — dashboards, scheduled reports, and warehouse/BI destinations.
definition.dc_zh:
- **渠道分类映射** — 一种机制，将原始接触点（URL参数、推荐来源、供应商名称）映射到管理好的渠道/来源/营销活动层次结构中，并显示未映射的事件以进行更正。
- **身份解析** — 通过设备ID、Cookie、电子邮件，或（在B2B中）联系人到公司的映射，将接触点与转化关联，跨设备和会话。
- **报告和导出** — 仪表板、计划报告，以及数据仓库/BI目的地。
definition.rules:
### One model at a time; switching re-allocates everything

The displayed credit is always credit *under a selected model*. Switching from last-touch to a data-driven model re-allocates the same conversions across the same journeys and changes every channel's numbers. Products treat model comparison as a core interaction.

### Credit is a fixed budget per conversion

Each conversion's credit is allocated once across its journey's touchpoints — whether 100% to one touch or fractions across many. This is why an attribution platform's channel totals reconcile to the advertiser's actual conversion count while each ad platform's self-reported totals sum to more than reality.

### Eligibility windows bound the journey

Touchpoints qualify for credit only within defined windows preceding the conversion (products commonly make these configurable, with view-through windows shorter than click-through). Outcomes with no qualifying touchpoint are classified as organic / unattributed / direct — a first-class bucket, not an error state.

### Deterministic evidence usually outranks modeled evidence

Where both deterministic links (referrers, device IDs, URL parameters) and probabilistic/modeled touchpoints exist, products commonly prioritize the deterministic ones; clicks commonly outrank impressions as stronger engagement signals. The exact priority rules are implementation-specific and differ most in the mobile ecosystem.

### Attribution numbers change retroactively

Late-arriving conversions, returns, model updates, and data backfills mean credited numbers for past periods can be revised. Products document this explicitly and provide revision/backfill handling; users are trained not to expect immutable history.

### Identity resolution is a prerequisite

Touchpoints can only be credited if they can be linked to the converting user. Traffic that cannot be resolved lands in direct/unspecified/anonymous buckets. In B2B implementations, resolution extends from the person to their company so journeys can be read at the account level.

### Discrepancy is structural, not a bug

Ad platforms measure their own campaigns with their own windows and credit rules, so their numbers will not match the independent allocation. Attribution platforms ship diagnostics for exactly this gap.
definition.rules_zh:
### 一次仅一个模型；切换重新分配一切

显示的信用始终是*在选定模型下*的信用。从最后触点切换到数据驱动模型，会在相同的旅程中重新分配相同的转化，并改变每个渠道的数字。产品将模型比较视为核心交互。

### 每次转化的信用是固定预算

每次转化的信用在其旅程的触点中仅分配一次——无论是 100% 给一个触点还是分数分配给多个触点。这就是为什么归因平台的渠道总数能与广告主的实际转化数协调一致，而每个广告平台自报的总数加起来超过现实。

### 资格窗口界定旅程

触点仅在转化前定义的窗口内才有资格获得信用（产品通常使这些可配置，展示窗口短于点击窗口）。没有合格触点的结果被归类为自然/未归因/直接——这是一个首要类别，而非错误状态。

### 确定性证据通常优先于建模证据

当同时存在确定性链接（推荐人、设备 ID、URL 参数）和概率/建模触点时，产品通常优先确定性链接；点击通常优先于展示，作为更强的互动信号。确切的优先级规则因实现而异，在移动生态系统中差异最大。

### 归因数字会追溯变化

迟到的转化、退货、模型更新和数据回填意味着过去时期的信用数字可能被修订。产品明确记录这一点并提供修订/回填处理；用户被训练不要期望历史是不可变的。
